# PT Launch Lab

> PT Launch Lab is a UK-based personal trainer academy founded by gym owners Callum Brown, Miles, and Ryan. We offer NCFE Level 2 & 3 Personal Trainer qualifications — 100% online, Ofqual regulated, CIMSPA recognised — with business mentorship, personal tutors, and guaranteed gym interviews built in. Based in Pontefract, West Yorkshire.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://ptlaunchlab.co.uk/): Overview of the PT Launch Lab course, unique method, social proof, and pricing
- [Courses](https://ptlaunchlab.co.uk/courses): Full course details — curriculum, PT Launch Method™, pricing, FAQs
- [Enrol](https://ptlaunchlab.co.uk/enrol): Start your application
- [Book a Call](https://ptlaunchlab.co.uk/book-call): Free 15-minute consultation with the founders
- [About](https://ptlaunchlab.co.uk/about): Our story, founders' backgrounds, values, and podcast
- [Quiz](https://ptlaunchlab.co.uk/quiz): Skills assessment to see if PT is right for you

## Key Facts

- Qualification: NCFE Level 2 & 3 Personal Trainer Certificate (Ofqual regulated, CIMSPA recognised)
- Duration: 4–8 weeks (self-paced, fully online)
- Price: £1,399 full payment or £599 deposit + 5 × £200 monthly payments
- Founders have hired 500+ personal trainers across their gym businesses
- 5.0★ Google rating
- Guaranteed gym interviews with partner gyms on qualification
- Personal tutor assigned throughout the course
- Business training included as a core module (not optional)
- Based in Pontefract, West Yorkshire, UK
